data.long_description:
Welcome to this stunning Type 4M middle unit located in the highly sought‐after Springs 15 community. This beautifully presented home offers a perfect blend of modern upgrades, functional layout, and serene outdoor living—ideal for families, professionals, or investors seeking a move-in-ready property.

The villa features 2 spacious bedrooms plus a study, providing flexibility for a home office, guest room, or nursery. The interior has been tastefully upgraded, enhancing both style and practicality throughout. Every space has been meticulously maintained, ensuring the property is in immaculate condition.

Key Features:

Type 4M, Middle Unit
2 Bedrooms + Study
Beautiful Upgrades Throughout
Immaculate, Move-in-Ready Condition
Fully Landscaped Private Garden
Prime Location within Springs 15

Step outside to a fully landscaped garden, designed for relaxation and outdoor entertainment. Whether you’re hosting family gatherings or enjoying peaceful evenings, the garden provides a private and tranquil setting.

Located in a quiet area of Springs 15, this home offers easy access to parks, lakes, community pools, and nearby amenities—delivering the perfect balance of comfort and convenience.
